subject.title: fix(gateway): regenerate native hook descriptors when relay unavailable after restart

question: Should a Codex native PreToolUse relay failure that occurs before a matching invocation record exists fall through to ordinary OpenClaw before-tool policy?
rationale: This changes fail-closed native tool transport behavior, and source/tests alone cannot establish whether maintainers accept the resulting security and operational tradeoff.

options.title: Accept after live proof
options.body: Keep the guarded fallback after exact-head restart proof demonstrates recovery and unchanged before-tool enforcement.

options.title: Preserve relay fail-closed
options.body: Require relay refresh or re-registration to succeed before native command approval may continue.

options.title: Pause the fallback change
options.body: Keep only the stale direct-bridge gateway retry while deferring the app-server policy fallback for separate design review.

recommendation.title: Accept after live proof
recommendation.body: Keep the guarded fallback after exact-head restart proof demonstrates recovery and unchanged before-tool enforcement.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the current guarded fallback contract and previously verified the corresponding upstream Codex hook semantics.
